source.section: IT 1040 lines 1 to 8a (bundle PDF p.1); booklet PDF p.16 lines 1 to 4; PDF p.17 line 4 exemption table and line 8a; PDF p.18 bracket table; PDF p.5 rounding; line 18 Ohio public obligations (PDF pp.20-21); MAGI PDF p.8; MAGI less exemptions worksheet PDF p.40

worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 38,050.00 = 38,050.00. Tax-exempt municipal interest is not in federal AGI. Federal taxable income = 38,050.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 22,300.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Ohio starts from federal AGI). IT 1040 line 1 federal AGI 38,050.00. Schedule of Adjustments additions: line 1 non-Ohio state or local interest 0.00; line 12 total 0.00; line 2a 0.00. Ohio municipal interest 4,000.00 is neither in federal AGI nor added, so nothing is deducted on line 18. Deductions: none; line 47 total 0.00; line 2b 0.00. Line 3 Ohio AGI = 38,050.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 38,050.00. Line 4: MAGI is line 3 with no business income deduction, 38,050.00, in the band 40,000 or less: 2,400.00 each; 1 exemption x 2,400.00 = 2,400.00. Line 5 = 38,050.00 - 2,400.00 = 35,650.00. Line 6 taxable business income 0.00. Line 7 = 35,650.00. Line 8a tax: 35,650.00 is in the 26,050 to 100,000 band: 342.00 plus 2.750% of (35,650.00 - 26,050.00 = 9,600.00) = 342.00 + 264.00 = 606.00. Schedule of Credits line 1 = 606.00. MAGI less exemptions (worksheet PDF p.40) = 38,050.00 - 2,400.00 = 35,650.00 (equal to line 7 without business income), under 100,000.00. Line 2 retirement income credit: no covered retirement income, 0.00. Line 4 senior citizen credit: no one is 65 or older, 0.00. Line 10 credits = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 11 = 606.00 - 0.00 = 606.00. State income tax 606.00. Ohio municipal interest is in neither federal AGI nor Ohio AGI, so MAGI stays under 40,000 and the exemption stays 2,400.
